deadline.value: Neither the department Ph.D. page nor the Rowan Global Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering page states an application deadline.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Biomedical Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Biomedical Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state whether pre-admission supervisor contact or agreement is required.

funding.value: The Biomedical Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state Ph.D. fellowship or assistantship funding terms.

entry_route.value: Entry requires a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) from an accredited institution (minimum 72 credits beyond the bachelor's, or 42 credits beyond a related master's).
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree (or its equivalent) from an accredited institution of higher learning
